name: mcp-events-bridge
description: Watch MCP Events bridge events (GitHub, Resend, webhooks) in the background: Claude is told as each one happens, between prompts too.

mcp_url.title: Bridge MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Your bridge's MCP URL, https://<bridge>/mcp/<BRIDGE_MCP_SECRET> (or http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp/<BRIDGE_MCP_SECRET> for a local bridge). It contains the secret, so it's kept in secure storage.
